items.t: Hockaday is a small board sub-area in north-central Coquitlam around Pinetree Way and Pinewood Avenue, on the Town Centre side of the city, in the wider Mundy Park / Como Lake orbit of central-north Coquitlam. "Hockaday" is the GVR sub-area name as it appears in the SnapStats GVR September 2026 report for Coquitlam.
Where the condo stock concentrates: nowhere.
Nearby areas: Central Coquitlam to the south, Canyon Springs and the City Centre / Town Centre Park area to the north and east, Eagle Ridge to the west, and Burke Mountain beyond to the north-east.

The detached stock is executive-house scale. The Hockaday listing index shows large single-family homes on McTavish Court and Pipeline Place (3,400–5,100 sq ft in the listings checked) — the sub-area's price conversation is a detached conversation, priced against the Coquitlam detached median of $1,455,000, not against any strata figure.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Hockaday

items.t: "Hockaday" is the GVR sub-area name as it appears in the SnapStats GVR September 2026 report. The working anchors are Pinetree Way and Pinewood Avenue, with Pinetree Secondary verified at 3000 Pinewood Avenue.
With counts this small, a single listing or sale swings every sub-area figure — treat the ratios as a snapshot of a very small market, not a trend.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Hockaday

items.t: City zoning frame: Zoning Bylaw No. 3000, 1996 — small-scale residential zones R-1, R-2 and R-3; minimum lot size for subdivision is 650 m² with 18.5 m width for R-1 and R-3, and 465 m² with 12.5 m width for R-2. The provincial small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) rules as adopted in Coquitlam allow up to 3 units on lots 280 m² or smaller and up to 4 units on lots larger than 280 m² and under 4,050 m², including secondary suites and carriage or laneway homes; lots not connected to municipal water or sewer are outside the SSMUH rules.

Strata rules, because there is no known strata stock to apply them to: if a strata townhouse is ever marketed in Hockaday, the diligence frame is Form B under Strata Property Act s. 59 (monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies, CRF balance, insurance summary, rules, budget, Rental Disclosure Statement and depreciation report attached; within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page); depreciation reports every five years for strata corporations with five or more lots since July 1, 2024; a CRF minimum contribution of 10% of the annual operating budget since Nov 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since Nov 24, 2022; and only 55+ age bylaws valid since Nov 24, 2022 (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + Regulation 7.01, exemptions expanded May 1, 2023).
Fee-simple reality in Hockaday: the stock is fee-simple detached housing — no strata, no Form B, no strata fees. A Hockaday house with a suite is still a fee-simple house, not a townhouse complex.

Hazards: the Watercourse Protection Development Permit Area covers all areas within 30 metres of the top of bank or top of ravine bank of any watercourse in this part of Coquitlam; Zoning Bylaw s.519 sets flood protection setbacks from watercourses and s.523 covers riparian areas.
The name itself is the trap. Always write "Hockaday, Coquitlam": a comp pull from another municipality's similarly named street will corrupt the price evidence.
The library anchor is on Pinetree Way: Coquitlam Public Library's City Centre branch is at 1169 Pinetree Way, the nearest full branch; the Poirier branch is at 575 Poirier Street.
The nearest hospital is across the municipal border: Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody (Fraser Health), on the Port Moody / Coquitlam border, is the nearest hospital for this area.
City Centre amenities are north-east, not in-area: the City Centre Aquatic Complex and Evergreen Cultural Centre sit in the City Centre area beyond the sub-area.
Coquitlam's 2021 Census population was 148,625, up 6.7% from 139,284 in 2016 (Statistics Canada, 2021 Census, Focus on Geography Series) — city context only.

Established-street house lots: The housing sits under the City's small-scale residential zones (R-1, R-2, R-3) around Pinewood Avenue, with Pinetree Secondary as the in-area anchor. A fee-simple lot carries no strata, no Form B and no strata fees.

Lot character, only: subdivision minimums under Zoning Bylaw No. 3000, 1996 are 650 m² with 18.5 m width in R-1 and R-3, and 465 m² with 12.5 m width in R-2; SSMUH unit counts turn on the 280 m² and 4,050 m² thresholds. These are zone minimums and thresholds, not a claim about any existing lot's size.
No ALR parcel and no ALR percentage split is stated.

Hazard position: the Watercourse Protection Development Permit Area covers all areas within 30 metres of the top of bank or top of ravine bank of any watercourse in this part of Coquitlam; Zoning Bylaw s.519 sets flood protection setbacks from watercourses and s.523 covers riparian areas. Lot-level watercourse / flood status is a property-specific check.

Assemblies / development sites / rezoning proposals: none documented as inventory: The city-wide OCP and the Transit-Oriented Areas work near Pinetree Way apply around the sub-area — planning frameworks, not assemblies and not for-sale land.
Historic subdivisions = built lot fabric, not offerings: the Pinewood Avenue street fabric is established built housing stock.

items.t: Main roads and transit: Pinetree Way and Pinewood Avenue serve the area. The nearest Evergreen Extension (Millennium Line) stations are Lincoln and Lafarge Lake-Douglas on Pinetree Way.

Civic anchors: Town Centre Park is a City park name in City records for this part of Coquitlam. Coquitlam Public Library City Centre branch, 1169 Pinetree Way, is the nearest full branch (Poirier branch at 575 Poirier Street; Library Link mobile service also serves Coquitlam); City Centre Aquatic Complex and Evergreen Cultural Centre are in the City Centre area north-east of the sub-area. Nearest hospital: Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Hockaday

items.t: If a parcel is in the ALR: subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified. On ALR land the main house can be up to 500 m², a suite is allowed only inside it, and an extra residence can be up to 90 m² (186 m² on parcels over 40 ha). For farm class, BC Assessment looks for farm income of $10,000 a year on under 0.8 ha, $2,500 on 0.8 to 4 ha, and $2,500 plus 5% of the value of land over 4 ha; applications are due by October 31.

The in-area anchor is a secondary school, and its own address settles its own catchment only: Pinetree Secondary is verified at 3000 Pinewood Avenue, inside the working anchors, and the locator run for that address returned Walton Elementary / Scott Creek Middle / Pinetree Secondary — a neat chain that still does not transfer one street over, because SD43 catchments are address-based.
